sourceFile: 40.BRS-2015 Report Test New Bond G06-0003 Date 3.5.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the bond change but has blocking outcome-pairing and evidence-grouping errors.
issues: Changed condition wrongly includes SM/YOKE vision as bond conditions.
YOKE vision compares new row to SM normal instead of YOKE normal.
One vision subresult mixes vision with separate-glue rows.
Measurement outcomes are auto-detected from headers and not reliable evidence.
Function result should be framed as roughly same, not clear improvement.
correctionPlan: Set primary factor to Normal Bond G06-0002 vs New Bond G06-0003.
Use SM VISION and YOKE VISION as subgroup outcome keys only.
Rebuild vision comparisons using matching inspection item rows.
Remove invalid header-derived measurement outcomes or recode as decap, tension, drop OK results.
Cite result and decision rows for function, separate glue, tension, and drop conclusions.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient because several comparisons cite mismatched or header-only rows.
